reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents Forsage BUSD as an earning opportunity with monthly income claims and large potential benefits, while instructing viewers to join paid slots using cryptocurrency or a wallet. It promotes x3, x4, and xGold matrix positions, sponsor or line-based benefits, repeated recycling for continuing returns, and referral-oriented participation through WhatsApp. The displayed returns and stability-related claims are promotional claims rather than independently verified outcomes, and the material does not establish completed transactions or realized earnings.

You will get income from your team or from upline or crossline
if your Downline got upgrade then its better with Super here

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker does not present every figure as a guaranteed personal payout. He acknowledges exchange-rate uncertainty, saying BUSD's rate is unstable, and invites viewers to examine materials about earlier projects and their problems themselves. His income calculation is expressly conditional on slots filling. Those qualifications matter when deciding whether the discussion is a deceptive promise rather than commentary on a proposed earning plan.

citations.quote: the rate of BUSD remains unstable in terms of USD
And also check if there are any additional problems and issues related to it. So, you can search this on your own on Pdf
once we collect all such slots, and it fills all the slots once

rebuttal.rebuttal: The monthly figure in the title establishes the subject of the video, not that a viewer is guaranteed that income. Likewise, the cited team-and-upline sentence describes where the plan says income can originate; it does not establish that a payment was made or conceal the condition that slots must fill. The prosecution itself notes the absence of verified earnings, which limits what can be concluded about outcomes.

citations.quote: How To Earn From Forsage 1000$ Monthly

once we collect all such slots, and it fills all the slots once

true_side_reply.rebuttal: An exchange-rate caveat and an invitation to search for problems do not qualify the speaker's central pitch. He calls joining a golden earning opportunity and says that, once a slot is bought, income will keep coming through recycling. The conditions in his calculation explain how the promoted returns are supposed to arise; they do not turn the promotion into neutral market commentary.

opening.argument: Judge, much of the presentation is an operational walkthrough. The speaker says viewers should understand the project first, points them to materials in two languages, and explains how positions and payments are arranged. Even the matrix illustration is a diagram of how the programs work. Explaining a system's rules and displaying its proposed calculations is not, by itself, evidence that the speaker has received the returns or induced a particular viewer to pay.

citations.quote: So to do this, you will have to understand the project first.
there are 2 PDFs in this article one in Hindi and other one in English

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats the matrix and sponsor terminology as decisive, but an explanation of positions must describe where payments would flow. Its title citation shows an earnings-oriented topic, not proof of realized earnings. The opening also concedes that completed transactions and realized earnings are not established. The narrower reading is that the viewer is being shown the proposed mechanics.

citations.quote: How To Earn From Forsage 1000$ Monthly

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The walkthrough does more than describe mechanics. It tells viewers what to pay to join through a wallet, recommends a starting set of paid slots, and presents repeated income from buying slots. A diagram can be instructional and promotional at the same time; the absence of verified payouts does not erase the invitation to participate in the paid matrix.

opening.argument: Judge, the record can be read as a paid referral program with stated slot prices and allocation rules, rather than proof of a fraudulent transaction. The speaker openly says that benefits may go to a sponsor or upline and discusses buying and upgrading slots; the referral structure is disclosed, not hidden. What the supplied material does not show is a viewer surrendering credentials, an actual transfer to the speaker, or a failed withdrawal. Those missing facts prevent the presentation alone from establishing how the program performs in practice.

citations.quote: The income you get in one slot or two slots ends up being your top sponsor.
The benefit of the left and right slots will be given to your upline.
As the income goes on, you will keep on upgrading and earning your slots.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's team-income and downline-upgrade examples show that the plan is referral-based, a point the speaker does not conceal. They do not show that anyone obtained the advertised return, lost a payment, or handed over credentials. Its WhatsApp point shows a contact channel, but the cited description does not itself establish a transaction.

For More Informatiom WhatsApp:

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Disclosure of a referral structure does not make it ordinary commerce. The pitch directs viewers to pay for entry, describes income from team and upline positions, and recommends buying several slots at the start. The concern is the promoted mechanism and promised earning opportunity, not whether this recording captures a failed withdrawal or a viewer giving up credentials.
